findings.title: Signature fallback can over-trigger on prose mentions of signature filenames
findings.description: The PROP-140 signature test runs against tool_use command body + head of tool_result text. Result-text matching means prose that merely mentions a signature filename (e.g. a summary discussing stranded-patches-*) can open a window without the command having run. Tinker's own transcript attributed 71% this way. Accepted for now: the instrument is directional, attribution_mode telemetry exposes fallback-mode rows, and Phase 1 structural markers are the precision path. WATCH: when next Mode 3 reads decider/integrity step-cost rows, sanity-check that signature-fallback windows correspond to steps the run actually executed; if windows look prose-polluted, narrow the test to command-body-only as a follow-up tweak.
findings.evidence: Live analyzer run on tinker transcript: per_step patch-strand:51 msgs driven by result-text mentions, not command executions.
